text.content:
From cheap knock-offs to the sharpest smart guns.

Headquarters: Kang Tao Tower, on the Corporate Plaza's inner ring (regional HQ)
Industry: Weapons, above all smart weapons
In Night City: A rising rival to Arasaka's arms business, buying Council votes faster than anyone

Kang Tao used to be known for copies of other people's guns. It came out of the Time of the Red as an innovator in smart weapon technology, and its guns now rival Arasaka's for quality and reputation.

In 2061 it took the last lot on the Corporate Plaza's inner ring. Kang Tao Tower is the newest building on it, and its lobby is a showroom for smart weapons you need a corporate license to touch. Chinese money with ambitions for a seat at the table, Kang Tao buys Council votes faster than anyone in the city.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.23; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05, 07
